hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are revelling in Manchester United's catastrophic form with gleeful schadenfreude, mocking their rivals' misplaced faith in Kobbie Mainoo and questionable transfer business. There's defensive pride in Arteta amid Liverpool fans' obsession, transfer rumours linking the Gunners with a Liverpool target, and a general sense that the North London project is on the right track while the Red Devils flounder. The Man City FFP saga draws cynical eye-rolls rather than genuine outrage.

daily.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment deteriorated sharply across the day, shifting from edgy post-international-break anxiety over performances and contracts to grumbly dissatisfaction with ticketing and a scrappy win, before culminating in incensed fury at the unresolved Man City charges rendering the season a 'farce.' The dominant narrative arc moves from performance panic to structural grievance, with media bias accusations and injury dread as constant undercurrents. A brief bright spot from the women's team offers the only respite in an otherwise darkening mood.

weekly.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment endured a turbulent week defined by a sharp but fleeting positive spike on October 1st — fueled by Odegaard's fitness and pride in the club's model — sandwiched between sustained frustration over the City financial scandal, transfer regrets, and a collapsing women's title challenge. The period trended decisively downward in its second half, with daily sentiment declining from cautious optimism into crisis mode by October 4th.
